title: Lab classifier P3: Router writes relevance_decision_is
description:
Monitoring router records each delivered lab decision as a relevance_decision_is relation (reuse relevance_decision_records; cyclotronId/classifierId = lab output; provenance account/run/binding); supersede the existing current relation (current_relevance_decision raises on two). Suggestion row + Agree/Overrule show for router-delivered refs.
Acceptance: router-delivered refs get a relation with provenance; a prior current relation is superseded (never two current); Suggestion row and Agree/Overrule render for router-delivered refs.

Size: M
Dependencies: none (related PPY-4ac3d0, PPY-106510)
Epic: Lab is the single classifier per publication (PPY-922416). Cyclotron-side epic: decision-flywheel-1b8b860d.
